historical_references.reference: Ilakkiya was a famous Tamil poet of the Sangam age, who lived around the 2nd century BC. He is known for his works in the Agam and Agananuruppatai collections.

Ilakkiya is also known for his association with the Chola dynasty, specifically with the reign of Rajaraja Chola I (985-1014 AD). He was a court poet during this period and his works were highly regarded.
